summary: Iteration 44: Fully verified the new 'Regras IA' tab on /definicoes and its backend endpoints for category overrides. Backend tests (/app/backend/tests/test_iter44_category_overrides.py, 3/3 PASS): (1) GET /api/bank-analysis/category-overrides/list returns a JSON array with desc_key/category/original_description/updated_at (no _id leaks). (2) End-to-end learning flow: uploaded a CSV with a VODAFONE transaction, polled analysis status, PATCH /api/bank-analysis/{aid}/transactions/{txn_id}?category=obra returned {ok:true, learned:true}, then GET list contained a 'vodafone' desc_key with category='obra'; DELETE with URL-encoded key returned {ok:true} and subsequent list confirmed removal. (3) DELETE on non-existent key returns 404. Frontend UI verified via Playwright with the real backend URL: admin login → /definicoes → clicked 'Regras IA' tab → empty state renders with Brain icon and 'Nenhuma regra aprendida ainda' + override-count badge '0 regras'. Then seeded a real override via API, reloaded the tab: overrides-list visible with 1 row, count badge '1 regra', delete-override-{desc_key} button visible; clicked delete → 'Regra eliminada' toast → row removed → count returned to '0 regras' → empty state reappears. All data-testids specified in the review (overrides-list, override-count, override-{desc_key}, delete-override-{desc_key}) are present and functional. Category label mapping (obra → 'Custo Obra' etc.) renders with colored pill via BANK_CAT_LABELS/BANK_CAT_COLORS.

issues: The 'edit' UI plumbing (editingKey/editCat state, handleUpdate) exists in code but is never rendered — there is no Edit button in the row. handleUpdate only deletes the override anyway, so the dead state can be removed to reduce noise. Not blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove unused editingKey/editCat/handleUpdate code from CategoryOverridesTab in /app/frontend/src/pages/DefinicoesPage.jsx (lines 192-193, 215-227) — currently dead code.
critical_code_review_comments: DefinicoesPage.jsx CategoryOverridesTab: correct use of encodeURIComponent(descKey) for DELETE with spaces in the key — matches backend path param. Good.
Delete UX: after delete the local state is filtered — no refetch — which is fine but if two admins are editing concurrently the UI won't reflect other's deletions until refresh. Not blocking for MVP.
Backend list endpoint correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection {_id:0} and sorts by updated_at desc — matches UI expectation of most-recent-first.
PATCH /transactions/{txn_id} uses category as a query param (not JSON body). The frontend AnaliseBancariaPage sends it that way too — consistent. Slightly unusual REST style but consistent.
Dead code smell: handleUpdate() in CategoryOverridesTab only deletes then shows a 're-learn via extrato' toast — misleading name; either wire a real PATCH endpoint or remove.
No pagination on list_category_overrides (500-doc cap). Fine for now; add pagination if the override count ever grows past a few dozen — 500 rows in a grid would be a UX issue anyway.
seed_data_creation: Test uploads a 1-row CSV (PAG VODAFONE TEST_UI_ITER44), creates a temporary bank_analysis + category_override. All cleaned up in finally blocks (analysis deleted, any lingering vodafone override deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Category overrides feature is fully functional end-to-end. Backend endpoints (GET /list, DELETE /{desc_key}, PATCH transaction learning) all working. Frontend Regras IA tab renders empty state, populated list, count badge, and delete button correctly. Only cosmetic issue: dead 'edit' state/handler in CategoryOverridesTab that never renders.
